caseName: Fletcher v. Evening Star Newspaper Co.
caseNameFull: Fletcher v. Evening Star Newspaper Co. and Fletcher v. Stephens
attorneys: Edmond C. Fletcher, pro se. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Shea, and Mr. Paul A. Sweeney for respondents in No. 901.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied. The Chief Justice is of the opinion that the petitions

should be granted.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.
